title: Domain must not depend on Infrastructure (TypeScript)
description: The Domain layer is the pure core of the TypeScript fixture and must not take a compile-time dependency on the Infrastructure layer. The reviewed ts-arch vitest spec tests/arch.spec.ts is the executable body this locked contract hashes (a single leaf spec); the fixture ships an intentional violation (src/domain/order.ts imports src/infrastructure/database.ts) so a real adapter run reports fail. lockedBodySha256 is the canonical Get-ArchLockedBodyHash digest over tests/arch.spec.ts.

rules.description: Files in the domain folder must not depend on files in the infrastructure folder.
